releases.summaryEn: 0.1.2 expands the route library with new ARAM: Mayhem playstyles, makes the right route easier to reach from the home screen, and brings the companion up to the 26.15 Mayhem update.
addedEn: Added 11 new official-style routes for Akshan, Briar, Gwen, Hwei, Ivern, Jarvan IV, Morgana, Neeko, Rell, Soraka, and Volibear.
Added curated Combo Plays to explain useful augment and item interactions.
Added New labels to recently published routes and homepage picks.
Added visible desktop app version information in the sidebar.
changedEn: Refined the Command Center with four focused new-route picks, complete six-item builds, and core augments at a glance.
Opening a homepage route now lands directly on that exact Combat File route instead of the champion default.
Reworked Combat File and overlay spacing so core augments, alternatives, starter items, and final items scan more cleanly.
Updated tactical notes to League of Legends 26.15 and limited the view to ARAM: Mayhem changes.
Tightened the Command Center layout by aligning the Champion Codex and recent matches, while removing low-value count cards.
fixedEn: Corrected Mayhem augment icons, names, and localized patch-note content through 26.15.
Fixed mixed-language labels in the English interface and improved long augment-name readability.
Kept local match history capped and displayed as 20 saved games maximum.
Removed the misleading in-app update page; public release availability is now handled by the packaged release flow.

public.summaryEn: 0.1.2 adds new ARAM: Mayhem routes, a clearer route-pick flow, updated 26.15 Mayhem notes, and a more focused desktop companion.
addedEn: 11 new routes and curated Combo Plays.
New labels for recently published routes and homepage picks.
A visible app version in the desktop sidebar.
changedEn: Homepage picks now open the exact route they represent.
Combat File, overlay, and Command Center layouts are easier to scan.
Tactical notes now cover 26.15 ARAM: Mayhem changes only.
fixedEn: Corrected Mayhem augment icons, localization, and long-name readability.
Local match history is clearly capped at 20 saved games.

releases.summaryEn: The first public Windows installer for Mayhempedia, with the Champion Codex, local-first client integration, and update checks.
releases.summaryZh: Mayhempedia 第一个公开 Windows 安装包，包含英雄图鉴、本地优先的客户端连接和版本检查。
addedEn: Published the first installable Windows beta.
Added configurable hotkeys and the initial desktop release flow.
Added a public homepage with the Combat File preview.
addedZh: 发布第一个可安装的 Windows 测试版。
新增可配置快捷键和基础桌面版本发布流程。
新增带 Combat File 预览的官网首页。

releases.summaryEn: The first Mayhempedia test build connected the Electron desktop shell to the League Client read-only interface.
releases.summaryZh: Mayhempedia 初始测试版打通 Electron 桌面窗口与 League Client 只读接口。
addedEn: Added the initial Electron desktop companion.
Connected to League Client state without reading game memory or automating gameplay.
Added the first Champion Codex and ARAM build data views.
addedZh: 新增基础 Electron 桌面伴侣应用。
连接 League Client 状态，不读取游戏内存，也不自动操作游戏。
新增第一版英雄图鉴和 ARAM 路线数据视图。
